FR-001.statement: Customers should be able to register, complete initial KYC verification, and log in with multi-factor authentication.

FR-002.statement: Customers should be able to view account balances and real-time transaction history for savings and checking accounts.

FR-003.statement: Customers should be able to initiate domestic fund transfers between internal accounts and to external beneficiaries.

FR-004.statement: Customers should be able to schedule recurring standing instructions and future-dated payments.

FR-005.statement: Customers should be able to apply for personal, vehicle, or mortgage loans online.

FR-006.statement: Customers should be able to download monthly account statements and tax certificates in PDF format.

FR-007.statement: Customers should be able to request debit card activation, temporary card freezing, and daily spending limit adjustments.

FR-008.statement: Customers should receive instantaneous SMS and push notifications for all debits, credits, and security alerts.

FR-009.statement: Customers should be able to report suspicious transactions or compromised credentials immediately.

FR-010.statement: Tellers should be able to log in securely using terminal authorization and biometric credentials.

FR-011.statement: Tellers should be able to process cash deposits and cash withdrawals against customer accounts.

FR-012.statement: Tellers should be able to verify customer signatures, photo identity documents, and account status.

FR-013.statement: Tellers should be able to issue cashier checks and process inter-branch account adjustments.

NFR-001.statement: All teller transactions exceeding configured threshold amounts must require mandatory supervisory override.

FR-014.statement: Tellers should perform end-of-day cash drawer balancing and generate teller reconciliation reports.

FR-015.statement: Loan officers should be able to review customer loan applications, credit scores, and uploaded income proofs.

FR-016.statement: Loan officers should be able to calculate debt-to-income ratios and generate proposed repayment schedules.

FR-017.statement: Loan officers should be able to approve, reject, or refer loan applications according to credit policy guidelines.

FR-018.statement: The system should calculate interest, track monthly installment payments, and flag delinquent accounts.

NFR-002.statement: The system should enforce role-based access control and strict separation of duties across all banking operations.

NFR-003.statement: All transactions must be immutably recorded in a tamper-resistant financial ledger.

FR-019.statement: The system should automatically monitor transactions against AML (Anti-Money Laundering) rule thresholds.

FR-020.statement: The system should flag high-value or suspicious patterns and generate regulatory compliance reports.

NFR-004.statement: All administrative changes, security policy updates, and manual ledger adjustments must be recorded in an audit trail.

NFR-005.statement: Customer financial records and account balances must be protected with strong database encryption at rest and in transit.
